title: Fallback attribution heuristics for region/tier routing observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: When the smart routing stack chooses a fallback (region tier fallback or a lower-capacity model variant), downstream debugging and SLO attribution are hard because decision logs are noisy, reasons are buried, and per-hop costs are not clearly attributed to the original routing rationale. Goal: introduce lightweight heuristics and compact event structure that attribute a fallback decision to the driving signal (capacity, latency spike, error rate, model-quality regression) and emit concise per-request metadata usable by the Console and SLO pipelines. Deliver a proof-of-concept encoding, ingest pipeline, and Console visualization tiles for debugging root causes of fallback cascades.
acceptance_criteria: Decision logs include a compact 'fallback_reason' field with one of {capacity, latency, error, quality, config} for >95% of fallback events
Per-request decision envelope contains a compressed 'fallback_chain' (max 3 hops) that lists prior variants/regions and timestamps
Console surfaces an interactive play-by-play for sampled fallback traces with per-hop latency and cost deltas
SLO attribution job can consume the new fields and attribute token/latency cost to original routing decisions in staging
End-to-end POC implemented behind a feature flag and validated on staging traffic with synthetic fallback scenarios
design_notes: Use a small enumerated reason field to keep event size low; avoid free-text explanations in the hot path

Compute a lightweight attribution score locally at the route-decision layer by combining: headroom_ratio, recent_tail_latency, error_rate_1m, and model_quality_delta; map top signal into 'fallback_reason'
Represent fallback_chain as a compact CSV: region:tier:variant@ts|region:tier:variant@ts — limits to 3 entries to bound size
Sampling: full payload capture only for 0.5% of fallback events; otherwise attach summary fields (reason, chain, score) only
Privacy/Security: avoid embedding prompt text in decision envelope; link to secure blob store for sampled frames
Backwards compatibility: fields added under decision_log.v2; routing agents should emit v1 for older consumers
implementation_plan: (Backend) Add lightweight attribution calculation inside route_decider module and emit new decision envelope fields
(Telemetry) Extend ingestion schema in routing-telemetry service and add transformation to dedupe redundant hop entries
(Storage) Create compressed column in provenance store to hold fallback_chain CSV, with a companion index for quick lookup
(Console) Wire a 'Fallback Inspector' panel that decodes chain, shows per-hop metrics and suggested remediation links
(Feature flag) Gate emission behind 'routing.fallback_observability.v1' with rollout to 10% traffic for validation
(Docs) Add spec doc in Confluence and a short developer guide for reading decision envelopes
testing_plan: Unit tests for attribution mapping (headroom -> capacity, tail latency -> latency, error thresholds)
Integration tests: synthetic orchestrated fallback across region A->B->C and verify chain captured and compacted
Load test: ensure added fields increase decision_log ingestion by <8% at 200k rps in staging
End-to-end: validate that SLO attribution job attributes token cost to initial fallback_reason under staging dataset
Security review: ensure sampled frames are stored in KMS-backed blob store and access is audited
rollout_plan: Enable feature flag for internal infra team (10% of routing agents) for 72 hours
Run canary checks: ingestion error rates, decision_log size, Console panel rendering times
Expand to 50% for 5 days, run SLO attribution comparisons against baseline
Full rollout after mitigation windows and sign-off from Observability PM
If regressions found, automatic revert via feature-flag and fallback to legacy decision_log.v1
